setup.intro: A few choices and Shrinkerr is ready: where your media is, how to encode it, which languages to keep and what happens to the originals. You can change all of it later in Settings.
setup.skip: Skip setup — I know what I'm doing

protect.title: Protect Shrinkerr with a password
protect.description: Anyone who can open Shrinkerr can change its settings and delete files. Set a username and password — or skip this if only you can reach it.
protect.descriptionDone: Password protection is on. You can change it in Settings → System → Authentication.

folders.title: Media folders
folders.description: Where your movies and shows are. Shrinkerr scans these folders; nothing changes until you convert something.
folders.empty: No folders yet — add at least one.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: The encoders this server can use. Hardware encoders are much faster; the CPU encoder makes slightly smaller files but is slow.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: How hard to compress. Savings are typical for H.264 sources; you can fine-tune this later in Settings → Video.

quality.name: Quality
quality.desc: Looks the same as the original.

max_savings.name: Max savings
max_savings.desc: Good quality and the smallest files; dark or grainy scenes can show it.

custom.name: Keep my settings
custom.desc: Your current quality setting isn't one of these presets.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Audio and subtitle tracks in other languages are removed when a file is converted or cleaned up. The original language of each film or show stays.
languages.subsHelp: Leave this empty to keep every subtitle.
languages.preview: What that means for a few of your files
languages.previewLoading: Reading a few of your files…

originals.title: Originals
originals.description: What happens to the original file once the converted one has taken its place.

password.title: Password
password.description: Anyone who can open Shrinkerr can change its settings and delete files. Set a username and password — or skip this if only you can reach it.

finish.title: Scan
finish.description: Shrinkerr scans your folders now. Watch the progress in the Scanner and pick what to convert there.

empty.title: No conversion data yet
empty.hint: Start scanning and converting files to see statistics here.

projection.sentence: At your current rate of {{rate}}/day ({{jobsPerDay}} jobs/day), converting the remaining {{files}} files ({{size}}) will take approximately {{duration}}.

bandwidth.description: Converted files use {{pct}}% less streaming bandwidth per viewer. For remote Plex streaming this means fewer buffering issues and lower upload usage.

audioRemoval.title: Audio Track Removal
audioRemoval.byLanguage: Tracks Marked for Removal by Language

cloud.title: Cloud Storage Savings
cloud.description: If your library were in the cloud, you'd save this much per month by reclaiming {{size}}:

drives.title: Drives Saved
drives.description: You've reclaimed {{amount}} — that's fewer drives you need:

efficiency.title: Encoding Efficiency by Source
efficiency.description: Which source types compress best? Higher % = more efficient. Focus encoding efforts on the best performers.
